name: West Virginia
feeText: Clerk of the circuit court fee for instituting an action for divorce, separate maintenance or annulment: $135 (W. Va. Code § 59-1-11(a)(3)).

otherFees.what: Petition to modify an order on custody, visitation, child support or spousal support (§ 59-1-11(a)(4))
Expedited modification of a child support order (§ 59-1-11(a)(5))
Parent education class fee, waived if indigent (§ 48-9-104(c)), maximum

residency.text: If married in West Virginia, one party must be a bona fide resident when the action is filed (no minimum duration); if married elsewhere, one party must have been a resident for the one year before filing (W. Va. Code § 48-5-105(a)).

simplified.text: Irreconcilable differences: divorce may be ordered when the complaint alleges irreconcilable differences and an answer admits it, without corroboration (W. Va. Code § 48-5-201). Alternatively, one year of living separate and apart is a ground (§ 48-5-202).

parentingClass.text: In a divorce involving a minor child the family court shall order the parties to attend parent education classes unless it finds attendance not appropriate or necessary; fee up to $25, waived for indigent parties (W. Va. Code § 48-9-104(b)-(c)).
